chunks: Ibn Udhaynah narrated from Zurarah, Bukayr, Muhammad ibn Muslim, al-Fuḍayl, and Burayd ibn Muawiyah, from one of the two Imams, peace be upon them.
The grandfather, together with the brothers from the father's side, is like one of the brothers.

key_terms.مِثْلُ وَاحِدٍ مِنَ ٱلْإِخْوَةِ: counted as equivalent to one brother in share calculation
key_terms.ٱلْإِخْوَةِ مِنَ ٱلْأَبِ: siblings related through the father’s side
key_terms.ٱلْجَدَّ: the grandfather as an heir in inheritance law

ai.seo_question: How is the grandfather treated in inheritance when paternal brothers are also heirs?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling in inheritance: the grandfather is counted like one brother when inheriting alongside paternal siblings. It is a concise fiqh principle for calculating shares within the law of kinship inheritance.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5639 - Ibn Udhaynah narrated from Zurarah, Bukayr, Muhammad ibn Muslim, Al-Fuḍayl, and Burayd ibn Muawiyah from one of the two Imams (peace be upon them) who said:
"The grandfather, when inheriting alongside the paternal siblings, is considered as one of the brothers."
